about: Published vulnerabilities in what a deployment installs that are NOT fixed yet, each with why it cannot reach a user of this app and a date to look again. scripts/qa/dependencies.mjs fails on an entry past its date, and on an entry for something no longer reported. Emptied 2026-10-23: next 15.5.27 -> 15.5.28 fixed a critical advisory (an RCE in image optimisation with SVG, and a server-action DoS), and postcss and deepmerge-ts are pinned to their fixed releases beneath Next and Prisma's config loader (package.json `overrides`), which cleared the four entries accepted on 2026-10-13 (postcss, deepmerge-ts, @prisma/config, prisma). Emptied again 2026-11-20: the picomatch GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf entries (picomatch, fdir, @rollup/pluginutils, @rollup/plugin-commonjs, @sentry/nextjs), accepted on 2026-11-17 until 2026-12-01, are no longer reported by npm audit, so the nightly's dependencies part asked for them to be taken off. effect (GHSA-7589-6fvf-x4pw, beneath @prisma/config, which pins it exactly) is pinned to its fixed release by package.json `overrides`.
